name: launch-empty
covers: The app starts with no archive, its window is findable by title, the toolbar and empty-state text are published to the accessibility tree, and the File menu opens with its items.

present.name: No archive open. Use File → Open Game Directory.

checks.note: Status bar. On macOS static labels are not findable by name through the backend, so this is skipped there.
The "Open Game" submenu only appears when installed games are detected, so it is not asserted.

phases.name: menu closes
phases.note: Clicking File again toggles the menu shut. An Escape key sent through the accessibility API does not reach egui on native Wayland, so the script does not rely on keys.

notes: Linux run 2026-11-11 (SteamOS, KDE Wayland) passed with bad-ass-mcp f7e77aa plus a local change that names a window after its first frame when the AT-SPI application name is empty; without that change the runner cannot find the window on Linux (see README). macOS and Windows names are the same strings but have not been run yet.
